requirements.text: The system shall ensure compliance with financial regulations and standards for ethical accountability.
The system shall implement user access controls with transparency measures to ensure secure and accountable data modification.
The system shall maintain an immutable audit trail of all transactions for a minimum of 5 years.
The system shall ensure accurate recording of financial transactions to prevent data loss or corruption.
The system shall implement double-entry bookkeeping principles to ensure integrity and prevent discrepancies.
The system shall validate currency conversions to ensure accuracy and prevent financial discrepancies.
The system shall provide error handling mechanisms to manage and recover from faults during transaction processing.
The system shall support safe degradation, allowing access to essential functionalities during partial outages.
The system shall perform regular backups of financial data to prevent loss in case of system failure.
The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are processed within 2 seconds to optimize responsiveness.
The system shall support concurrent processing of at least 100 users to ensure adequate throughput.
The system shall generate financial reports in under 5 seconds for datasets up to 10,000 transactions.
The system shall implement caching for frequently accessed data to reduce latency by at least 50%.
The system shall ensure that currency conversion operations complete within 3 seconds for real-time transactions.
The system shall maintain an audit trail that logs each transaction with a maximum logging delay of 1 second.
The system shall minimize energy consumption during data processing by using efficient algorithms and data structures.
The system shall support document digitization to reduce paper usage by at least 80%.
The system shall include mechanisms for users to report ethical concerns or violations confidentially.
